value.data: A luxury high-rise project offering modern architecture and premium features. It ensures excellent access to the Airport and Manyata Tech Park.. Configurations: 3 BHK, 4 BHK

Sumadhura Epitome 1 is generally perceived as a luxurious residential project offering modern living with a wide range of amenities and excellent connectivity to key areas in North Bangalore. While the developing surrounding infrastructure presents some challenges like dusty roads and water facilities, the overall sentiment highlights a sophisticated and comfortable lifestyle.
